archetype: Electric & Neon (Modified for consumer music app)

onboarding.layout: Flex column, center aligned content. Top half for floating music tiles illustration, bottom half for text and CTA.

languageSelection.layout: Flex column, padding horizontal 24px. Header top, scrollable list of language cards, fixed bottom CTA area.

mainLibrary.layout: Flex column. Top navigation row -> horizontal filter chips -> FlatList of songs -> bottom padding for mini player.

fullPlayer.layout: Modal or Stack screen. Flex column, space-between. Top header (dismiss), large square cover art in center, track info, scrubber, playback controls at bottom.

miniPlayer.shadow: Drop shadow underneath to elevate from list

app_icon.description: Black penguin with yellow headphones, use as primary app logo and in-app mascot.

demo_album_covers.description: Demo track cover 1 - red and blue abstract
Demo track cover 2 - warm abstract swirl

animation_and_motion.pageTransitions: React Navigation default slide-from-right for iOS, fade/scale for Android.
animation_and_motion.miniPlayer: Slide up from bottom when first track is selected.
animation_and_motion.listItems: Staggered fade-in for song list on initial load.
animation_and_motion.interactions: Scale down slightly (0.95) on press for buttons and song cards (TouchableOpacity / Pressable with scaling).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure yellow text/icons on dark background meets 4.5:1 ratio. Black text on yellow background meets it.
accessibility.testIds: All interactive components must have data-testid (or testID for React Native) assigned.
accessibility.touchTargets: Minimum 44x44 points for all tap targets (icons, buttons).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use React Native StyleSheet for styling. Do not use web CSS or Tailwind unless explicitly requested by the stack (e.g., NativeWind).
Match the screenshots exactly: Dark Navy/Black background (#0A0A0E) with Yellow Accent (#F5C518).
Implement the floating mini-player as an absolute positioned view sitting above the Bottom Tab Navigator or screen bottom, with a high zIndex.
Use react-native-vector-icons (or Expo vector icons like Ionicons/Feather) for all UI icons (search, sort, play, pause, shuffle).
For the mascot/app icon, fetch the image from the provided URL. Do not use text placeholders.
Implement the layout precisely for mobile viewports, relying heavily on Flexbox.
Files are structured as standard .js files for React Native. Keep components clean and use StyleSheet.create().
